lockedMove.speaker: Joel Settecase
lockedMove.proposition: Reasoning and communication already presuppose invariant identity, stable linguistic meaning, interpersonal correspondence, and an intelligible reality rather than deriving all such conditions from experience.
lockedMove.sourceExcerpt: reality. You know you're presupposing the law of identity which is an invariant immaterial unchanging universal objective knowable mental entity that is true irrespective and totally independent of human minds. You're presupposing the intelligibility of language. or presupposing that your mind and my mind correspond in some way that language is a sufficient um even necessary means of communicating

components.text: It argues that the assertion that reality remains reality already relies on an invariant law of identity.
It contests the denial of antecedent presuppositions by identifying identity and linguistic intelligibility used in the argument.
It asserts that identity is an objective, mind-independent mental entity rather than merely a sentence.

lockedMove.speaker: Tom Jump
lockedMove.proposition: Logic, mathematics, and linguistic concepts are conclusions developed from experience rather than foundational presuppositions, and conversational assumptions do not constitute justificatory premises about reality.
lockedMove.sourceExcerpt: logic and math and language from my experience. So, these are not things I presuppose. These are things I come up with after the fact of my experience. So, they're not presuppositions. I'm not starting with these things.
